open_presence_rule.what: the presence rule `open` judges by since the fix check, against the kit's (writer._look): the installed command's kit_marker, bin/analytics's kit_marker under /bin/sh (bash 3.2 as sh) and /bin/dash, on one entry named analytics.json each (kit_marker_parity.py; macOS, whose link limit is 32)
open_presence_rule.note: chain_N is N links after the entry's own (N + 1 in all). bin/analytics follows a link stat cannot follow link by link and counts it after 32 links, the smaller of macOS's and Linux's limits (32, 40): on Linux it also counts a chain of 33 to 40 links that leads nowhere, which the kit does not count (not measured on Linux), so it never passes over a chain the kit counts. An entry in a directory that cannot be searched (EACCES) is not covered

gate_cost.what: core.add_note into a lab.json project whose journal has 1,000 lines, 200 notes, mean per note; base 5829c7c and the fix-check commit alternating four times (as the second measure: PR #76's way is twice, and the second measure's head spread 2.03–2.18 ms), the minimum of each; writer.marker_state and core.admit alone, 2,000 calls each; the judgments of one add_note and one append_event, counted by wrapping writer.marker_state; one judgment of an analytics.json with mode 000 (gate_cost_fix.py)
gate_cost.judgments_note: add_note and append_event judge three times: their own admit (a refused write answers before a validation error), journal_lock's before the lock (its file is the first side effect) and the one under the lock. A kit command line's `record` judges once more before it imports anything (__main__), and its context sync twice (journal_lock)

unreadable_marker.note: a marker that stays unreadable (EACCES here) is read again within the replace budget (design 4.3), so each judgment of it costs about 2 s. aelix's tool_execution_end hook judges twice, synchronously (finding the project, the telemetry side write), so a tool call in such a project would wait about 4 s: counted from the judgments, not measured in an aelix session (CONTRACTS G)
